title: HC to govt: ensure water for all, file drought affidavit by Dec 9

slides.head: HC to govt: ensure water for all, file drought affidavit by Dec 9
What happened
slides.body: A bench of Acting Chief Justice P Sam Koshy and Justice Suddala Chalapathi Rao said the situation 'was not man-made and the govt cannot be blamed', but asked for the measures taken, per TOI.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Telangana got 630.1 mm of rain from June 1 to Oct 31 against a normal 833.1 mm, a 24% deficit, per the petitioners.

slides.head: Did you know
slides.body: Telangana needs about 409 tmc of drinking water; about 200 tmc is available, petitioners said.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: The government's affidavit on drinking water measures at the December 9 hearing. Ask: How will the government's affidavit measure whether water reaches every citizen?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

captions.instagram:
HC to govt: ensure water for all, file drought affidavit by Dec 9

Hearing a PIL on El Niño-induced drought, the Telangana High Court said its concern is not how the government sources water but whether every citizen gets it, and sought a detailed affidavit. The case returns on December 9.

Why it matters: Telangana got 630.1 mm of rain from June 1 to Oct 31 against a normal 833.1 mm, a 24% deficit, per the petitioners.

Source: Times of India. Image: Times of India
